title: Cave Mouth
template: Rain hammers the hillside behind you. The cave narrows fast — daylight gives up a few strides in, and the walls carry old tool marks that were never made by human hands. Wind moans through a crack low on the east wall. A crude straw pallet slumps against the north wall, goblin-sized but serviceable.

exits.label: down the tunnel
exits.desc: a stooped passage descending into dark

exits.label: the crack in the east wall

pallet.desc: a straw sleeping pallet, filthy but dry

sleep.message: The player sleeps rough but deep. They wake rested; the storm outside has faded to a drizzle.

loose_stone.desc: a flat stone that rocks underfoot — something glints in the hollow beneath

ghost_hints.whisper: The player hasn't noticed the floor — one stone near the pallet sits proud of the rest. Let their torchlight catch it.

player_desc: A storm chased you into a hillside cave that turns out to be goblin tunnels. Somewhere below, they hoard a moonstone amulet. Get it, get out.

player_hints.text: Old hideouts keep their secrets in the walls — a careful search here pays.
